question: Where was the 2024 International Conference of NGOs organised by UNESCO held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paris, France**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 2024 International Conference of NGOs under UNESCO was **organized in Paris, France**, where UNESCO’s headquarters are located.
 
• This conference is a biennial event that brings together UNESCO’s **official NGO partners** to discuss and align strategies for global development and cooperation.
 
• Paris has hosted numerous key UNESCO events, emphasizing its role as a global center for education, culture, and science.
 
• The conference primarily focuses on **strengthening collaboration between UNESCO and NGOs** to address global challenges like education, heritage preservation, and sustainable development.
 
• The event serves as a platform to **review and strategize UNESCO’s partnership frameworks** with non-governmental organizations (NGOs).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNESCO (United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization)**

 
 
• Established in **1945**, UNESCO aims to promote international collaboration in education, science, and culture.
 
• Its headquarters is situated in **Paris, France**.
 
• UNESCO is known for its **World Heritage Sites program**, which recognizes culturally and naturally significant locations worldwide.
 
• Other key focus areas include **education for all**, freedom of expression, and fostering scientific cooperation.
 
 
 
• **International Conference of NGOs**
 
 
• This conference is held every two years and involves UNESCO’s official NGO partners.
 
• It aims to assess the **collective impact** of NGOs in UNESCO’s priority areas and discuss future collaborations.
 
• The conference also provides a platform to **share best practices** and innovative solutions for global challenges.
 
• It helps in aligning NGO activities with UNESCO’s objectives for sustainable development.
 
 
 
• **NGOs in partnership with UNESCO**
 
 
• UNESCO collaborates with over **400 NGOs worldwide** to achieve its goals in education, science, and culture.
 
• These NGOs play a critical role in implementing grassroots programs and providing technical expertise.
 
• Partnerships are based on a framework agreement that outlines specific areas of cooperation.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO’s Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**
 
 
• UNESCO actively contributes to achieving the **UN’s 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development**.
 
• Its work focuses on **Quality Education (SDG 4)**, Gender Equality (SDG 5), and Climate Action (SDG 13), among others.
 
• Partnerships with NGOs are vital for mobilizing resources and implementing SDG-related initiatives.
